svg.text: every RTL-SDR has a spike at its own tuning frequency; it stays out of the channel
1.152 MHz ÷ 16 = 72 kHz = exactly 4 samples per 18 kBd symbol: no fractional resampler
a neighbour 25 kHz away, 9 dB stronger, dragged the FLL about 2 kHz off before I added it
π/4-DQPSK carries its data in the change of phase, so the absolute carrier phase never matters
